title: Kaohsiung vs Tainan: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Tainan for history, food, and authentic Taiwanese culture. Kaohsiung for transit, beaches, modern city life, and easier logistics. They're 40 minutes apart — do both.

categories.name: Food & Street Food
categories.summary: Tainan is Taiwan's undisputed street food capital — coffin bread, danzai noodles, oyster vermicelli. Kaohsiung has excellent night markets but can't match Tainan's food heritage.

categories.name: History & Culture
categories.summary: Tainan is Taiwan's oldest city (400+ years), with Dutch forts, Qing-dynasty temples, and colonial alleys. Kaohsiung has Fo Guang Shan and Pier-2 Art Center but less historical depth.

categories.name: Public Transit
categories.summary: Kaohsiung has a full MRT system (Red + Orange lines, light rail). Tainan has no MRT — requires scooter, taxi, or YouBike.

categories.name: Beaches & Nature
categories.summary: Kaohsiung has Cijin Island beach and proximity to Kenting National Park. Tainan has wetland nature (Taijiang) but no swimming beaches.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Kaohsiung has more nightlife volume — harbor bars, Pier-2, Ruifeng Night Market. Tainan has Shennong Street (atmospheric craft beer in colonial buildings) but fewer options.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Tainan is slightly cheaper (~NT$200–300/day) due to omnipresent cheap street food. Both are significantly cheaper than Taipei.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Kaohsiung accesses Kenting (beaches), Xiao Liuqiu (sea turtles), and Meinong. Tainan's day trips are more modest but it's easy to day-trip Kaohsiung from Tainan.

categories.name: English Friendliness
categories.summary: Kaohsiung MRT and major attractions have bilingual signage. Tainan's historic lanes are less English-friendly.

categories.name: Walkability
categories.summary: Tainan's compact historic core is very walkable. Kaohsiung's MRT compensates for its larger spread.

categories.name: Proximity to Each Other
categories.summary: 15 minutes by HSR, 40 minutes by TRA. Do both.

faq.question: Is Kaohsiung or Tainan better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Reddit is split. Tainan for history, culture, and food authenticity. Kaohsiung for transit, beaches, and ease of navigation. Most itineraries include both since they're 40 minutes apart.

faq.question: How far apart are Kaohsiung and Tainan?
faq.answer: 15 minutes by HSR (NT$160–190), 40–50 minutes by TRA express (NT$69–106). Day trips between them are very easy.

faq.question: Which has better street food?
faq.answer: Tainan by a wide margin — it's Taiwan's street food capital with dishes invented here centuries ago.
